subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should the remaining fix for #86684 require both provider-safe parent-wake usage accounting and persisted compaction trigger metadata, or should one of those be split into a narrower follow-up?
rationale: Current main partially improves token accounting, but the unresolved trigger metadata and fallback behavior affect persisted transcript shape and compaction policy beyond a routine bug patch.

options.title: Fix both before closing
options.body: Require a focused design/fix that proves subagent-yield wake compaction on current main and persists a closed trigger reason for future attribution.

options.title: Narrow to live usage proof
options.body: Close only the accounting part after a live current-main proof and file a separate metadata issue for trigger attribution.

options.title: Split into two canonicals
options.body: Track usage/overflow behavior and compaction-entry metadata as separate issues if maintainers want different owners or release timing.

recommendation.title: Fix both before closing
recommendation.body: Require a focused design/fix that proves subagent-yield wake compaction on current main and persists a closed trigger reason for future attribution.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance for the touched usage and compaction-entry surfaces points to this recent area contributor.
